name: Paphos, Cyprus

visa.notes: Category F permit requires ~€9,568/year + €4,613/dependent. Must deposit €15K-€30K in Cypriot bank. Very retiree-friendly.

rent.notes: Paphos Q1 2026 3BR house averages: Konia EUR 1,050, Kato Paphos/Emba EUR 1,100, Chlorakas EUR 1,150, Tala EUR 1,250, Peyia EUR 1,350 (Coral Bay EUR 1,800). Sea views add 25-40%.

sources.title: Houses for Rent in Paphos guide (index.cy)

utilities.notes: Tenant pays electricity at EUR 0.26/kWh (AC-driven summer peaks); water and trash (EUR 70-120/yr) often billed via water bill or included. Internet excluded.

sources.title: Houses for Rent in Paphos guide (index.cy)
Cyprus household power costs ease from 2023 peak (Cyprus Mail, Eurostat H1 2026 EUR 0.26/kWh)

healthcare.notes: GeSY 2.65% on pension/passive income: about EUR 148/mo for the couple on ~USD 72k (EUR 67k); plus local top-up cover EUR 40-210/mo per person at 55-65 (typical ~EUR 120 each). Max assumes a full international plan (EUR 150-300 each) if GeSY access is not granted on their permit type.

sources.title: How healthcare works in Cyprus: GeSY explained (Cyprus Mail)

entertainment.notes: Mid-range 3-course dinner for two about EUR 60 in Paphos, ~4x/month = EUR 240; plus home fibre and streaming (~EUR 60, not separately verified) and activities.

sources.title: Why Limassol tops Cyprus in housing and living costs in 2026 (index.cy)

taxes.notes: Estimated monthly income tax on $72,000/yr household income. Based on jurisdiction's effective retiree rate; excludes sales/VAT/property tax.

medicine.notes: Monthly prescription medication costs for household

medicalOOP.notes: GeSY co-pays are small (GP free, specialist EUR 6 with referral, EUR 1 per Rx/lab item, A&E EUR 10) and capped at EUR 150/person/yr (~EUR 25/mo for two); typical adds occasional private consults (GP EUR 50-150, specialist EUR 150-300) and adult dental not covered by GeSY.

sources.title: Health Insurance in Cyprus: a plain guide (Insurance Edge)
How healthcare works in Cyprus (Cyprus Mail)

healthcare.system: GESY (General Healthcare System) introduced 2019. Paphos General Hospital for basic care. Private clinics good and affordable.
healthcare.waitTimes: Public: 2-8 weeks for specialists. Private: under 2 weeks.
healthcare.prescriptionCoverage: GESY covers most prescriptions with small co-pays

pros: Massive British expat community, English widely spoken
Warm year-round climate with 340 days of sunshine

pros.text: Very favorable tax treatment for retirees: optional 5% flat tax on foreign pension income above €3,420/yr (or normal progressive brackets) + separate 2.65% GeSY health contribution
